citations.quote: When you're talking to an investor and you are selling off plan and this is an off plan investor, you have to reframe the general idea

observation.text: The speaker structures the insight about investor behavior as a sequence starting with a common belief ('the market has stopped'), followed by a strategic recommendation to reframe that belief.

citations.quote: you have to reframe the general idea that he will bring to the table. This idea is the market has stopped.

summary.text: When talking to an investor selling off plan, reframe the idea that an off plan investor brings, which is that the market has stopped, and they can wait to purchase when prices fall to rock bottom.
